title: historically — organizational

sentences.sentence: And historically they acted with that sense of stewardship in mind, thinking of what was appropriate for the whole system and not simply for their firm.
sentences.translation: 而且在历史上，他们也在心目中带有那种使命感，思考的是什么对这个社会是最好的，不仅仅是对自己的公司。

sentences.sentence: After all, historically, the two nations have been enemies.
sentences.translation: 毕竟在历史上，两个国家曾经是敌人。

sentences.translation: 因为历史上我们从未在宪法中给婚姻下过定义。

sentences.sentence: Smith said the crimson anthocyanin protects the delicate mechanisms that allow the tree to extract all the nutrients from its leaves.

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 181 单元

historically
音标：英 /hɪ'stɒrɪklɪ/  美 /his'tɔrikəli/
adv. 历史上地
例句：And historically they acted with that sense of stewardship in mind, thinking of what was appropriate for the whole system and not simply for their firm.
而且在历史上，他们也在心目中带有那种使命感，思考的是什么对这个社会是最好的，不仅仅是对自己的公司。
例句：After all, historically, the two nations have been enemies.
毕竟在历史上，两个国家曾经是敌人。
例句：Because historically, we have not defined marriage in our constitution.
因为历史上我们从未在宪法中给婚姻下过定义。

disorient
音标：英 /dɪs'ɔ:rɪent/  美 /dɪsˈɔriˌɛnt, -ˈor-/
v. 使失去方向感, 使迷惑

anthocyanin
音标：英 /,ænθə(ʊ)'saɪənɪn/  美 /,ænθə'saɪənɪn/
n. [植]花青素, [化]花色醣苔
例句：Smith says that some species, most famously maples, produce anthocyanin during autumn as a kind of antioxidant for trees.
史密斯说，一些物种，例如最有名的枫树，在秋天会产生的一种抗氧化剂的花青素。
例句：Smith said the crimson anthocyanin protects the delicate mechanisms that allow the tree to extract all the nutrients from its leaves.
史密斯说，深红色的花青素保护着微妙的机制，它让树木从叶子里提取所需要的全部营养物。
例句：The canopy pictured above gets its crimson hue from a pigment called anthocyanin, the same component that lends red cabbage its intense color.
图中华盖的深红色调来自一种称为花青素的色素，这种色素与红叶卷心菜的浓烈色彩有着相同的成分。

acidic
音标：英 /ə'sɪdɪk/  美 /ə'sɪdɪk/
adj. 酸的,酸性的
短语：acidic solution — 酸溶液；质酸原液
短语：acidic protein — n. 酸性蛋白质（有时特指非组蛋白）
短语：acidic gas — 酸性气体
短语：weakly acidic — 弱酸性的
例句：Some fruit juices taste a bit acidic.
有些果汁味道略酸。

elder
音标：英 /'eldə/  美 /'ɛldɚ/
n. 年长者, 老人
短语：elder brother — 哥哥，兄长
短语：elder sister — 姐姐，姊姊
例句：a meeting of the village elders
村里长辈们的集会

modification
音标：英 /,mɒdɪfɪ'keɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,mɑdɪfɪ'keʃən/
n. 更改, 修改
短语：surface modification — 表面改质；表面饰变
短语：chemical modification — 化学修饰；化学改质
短语：profile modification — 齿形修整
短语：equipment modification — 设备修改
短语：weather modification — 人工影响天气
短语：behavior modification — 行为矫正
短语：modification coefficient — 变位系数
短语：data modification — 数据修改
短语：addendum modification — 齿高变位量；齿顶高修正
例句：They have used the same process for almost 50 years with only minor modifications .
同样的工序他们用了将近50年，期间只做过很小的改动。

anyone
音标：英 /'enɪwʌn/  美 /'ɛnɪ'wʌn/
pron. 任何一个
例句：Anyone could win tonight.
今晚任何人都可能赢。
例句：They offer help and advice to anyone interested in becoming a teacher.
他们为任何有兴趣当老师的人提供帮助和咨询。
例句：If anyone sees Lisa, ask her to call me.
如果有谁看见莉萨，叫她打电话给我。
例句：Anyone else who is interested in going on the trip should see me at the end of this lesson.
还有谁有兴趣参加此次旅行，下课来找我。

音标：英 /'fɪŋgəbɔːd/
n. 键盘
例句：I'm just doing it with a series of switches instead of a fingerboard, which we obviously don't have-- Okay. That's fine. That's great.
只是我用的是阀键,代替圆号上很明显没有的指板,好的,很棒

watercraft
音标：英 /'wɒtəkræːft/  美 /'wɔtəkræft/
n. 船只
例句：Either way it seems certain that these people were using quite sophisticated technology and watercraft to fish offshore.
不管人们用的那种方法抓鱼，似乎可以肯定，那些人使用了娴熟的技术和船只。
例句：People use “jet ski” to refer to a wide variety of personal watercraft; “rollerblade” to mean any inline skates—and “chupacabra” to mean any weird animal.
人们用“jet ski”这个词组表示各种各样的个人船只；用“rollerblade”这个词表示任何直排轮滑——也用“卓帕卡布拉”来表示任何神秘的动物。
例句：When the Coast Guard spotted the vessel off the coast of Honduras, its crew sank the watercraft. They were later detained, according to a Coast Guard press release.
据海岸警卫队透漏的消息，当海岸警卫队在洪都拉斯海岸截获该船的时候，船员将船沉入到了海底，随即，他们被拘捕了。

buildup

这种清漆有6种天然木材的色泽可选。

音标：英 /'wɔːfeə/  美 /'wɔrfɛr/

短语：trench warfare — 堑壕战

现代战争的真实面貌

cop
音标：英 /kɒp/  美 /kɑp/
n. 警官, 巡警
短语：no cop — 没价值，不值钱；没用处
短语：traffic cop — n. [口]交通警察
短语：cop out — [美俚]逃避；放弃；自首并告密；避重就轻地认罪
例句：the local cop

缉毒警官
例句：He pulled out his badge and said he was a cop.
他拿出警徽说自己是警察。

symbiosis
音标：英 /,sɪmbɪ'əʊsɪs; -baɪ-/  美 /,sɪmbaɪ'osɪs/
n. [生]共生(现象),合作关系
例句：...the link between bacteria, symbiosis, and the evolution of plants and animals.
...细菌、共生和动植物进化间的联系。

presidential
音标：英 /,prezɪ'denʃəl/  美 /'prɛzədɛnʃəl/
adj. 总统的
短语：presidential election — 总统选举；总统大选
短语：presidential candidate — 总统候选人
短语：presidential palace — 总统府

该党的总统候选人

音标：英 /spʌn(d)ʒ/  美 /spʌndʒ/

n. 内脏
